access_form.purpose: GPT-Rosalind research-preview MODEL access. Not benchmark data. Requires legal entity, OpenAI Org ID, government-ID verification.

contributor_form.purpose: Recruits Ph.D. life scientists to author future benchmark tasks. Not a data-request route.

public_record.data_availability_statement: Preprint appendix A.5: public release of tasks, rubrics, artifacts, or evaluation materials may be limited by licensing, privacy, proprietary information, or biological safety considerations.

published_reference_results.note: Provider-reported, for context only. NOT a measurement by this lane.

schema_reconciliation_findings.action: Reconcile once the evaluation interface is obtained. Not changed unilaterally: pavlovs_domain_contract.json declares stateful=true for this suite.
schema_reconciliation_findings.finding: The local boundary models an agentic, stateful, observation-action-artifact environment (NATIVE_OBSERVATION_SCHEMA, stateful=true, reset_per_task=true). The published benchmark is SINGLE-TURN free-response with rubric grading.

schema_reconciliation_findings.action: Metric keys must be remapped before any real run, or the logged numbers will not mean what their names say.
schema_reconciliation_findings.finding: WANDB_REQUIRED_METRICS are eval/lifescibench_{success_rate,reward_mean,action_count_mean}. The provider's metrics are normalized rubric score and task pass rate at a 0.70 threshold.

schema_reconciliation_findings.action: Resolved: the published taxonomy is now carried separately on task rows as workflow and bio_domain.
schema_reconciliation_findings.finding: ALLOWED_DOMAINS is the campaign capability tag set (science/long_horizon/tool_use) from pavlovs_domain_contract.json, not LifeSciBench's biological taxonomy.

synthetic_fixture.notice: Synthetic local-plumbing fixture. Contains no Life-Sci-Bench task, artifact, rubric, or measurement. Produces no score. Rejected by validate_e8_boundary and validate_e8_receipt by design.
synthetic_fixture.sole_boundary_error: payload carries the SYNTHETIC-NOT-LIFESCIBENCH marker: a synthetic fixture is local plumbing scaffolding and can never be Life-Sci-Bench data, a Life-Sci-Bench result, or a score
